description: Space on Earth aims to help farmers cope with changing temperatures, rainfall patterns, water scarcity, and wildfires. Our goal is to build a simple, easy to understand platform that supports producers. Preventing natural disasters like water scarcity and wildfires while ensuring mutual profit for both farmers and buyers is our core purpose.
summary: Space on Earth is a user friendly platform that turns NASA satellite data into simple, practical, and localized insights for farmers. Through its automated field boundary detection system, Space on Earth aims to support sustainable and organic agriculture by giving producers easy access to vital information such as water usage, scoring based crop selection, crop rotation, and optimal timing. To combat approaching climate threats, the platform features an early warning system that uses NASA thermal and anomaly data to detect wildfire risks before fires start, enabling emergency response teams to be deployed to the area in advance to protect the lives of responders, producers, and farmlands. Furthermore, through a dedicated certification and incentive system for water saving and organic farmers, Space on Earth promotes priority access in supply chains, aiming to ensure mutual profit and economic benefit for both producers and buyers. Combined with its easy to understand, color coded interface and smart input thresholds, Space on Earth makes space data simple for everyone to use, helping prevent water scarcity and devastating disasters.
details:
🌍 What It Does & How It Works

Space on Earth is a practical web platform that turns NASA satellite data into clear, actionable guidance for farmers and emergency responders. Using NASA climate and thermal satellite observations alongside global agricultural crop standards, the platform analyzes selected farm locations to provide tailored crop recommendations, water need categories, sowing and harvest windows, and crop rotation guidance. At the same time, its early warning layer monitors heat anomalies to detect wildfire risks early, helping emergency teams protect lives and farmlands. To ensure accessibility for producers across different regions, the live platform currently supports accurate translation into 9 languages. 

🌱 Benefits, Intended Impact & Future Vision

Our core goal is to make sustainable agriculture accessible, affordable, and profitable. By guiding producers toward water-smart crop choices and accurate planting schedules, Space on Earth helps prevent severe water scarcity and crop loss caused by shifting temperatures and irregular rainfall. Beyond farm productivity, our early fire alerts safeguard the lives of both firefighters and farmers. For the next phase of our project designed to be carried out with local governments and agricultural institutions we propose routing early thermal alerts directly to the nearest on duty fire station to pre-position crews during high risk time windows, alongside a "Sustainability Certification" and incentive model that would reward water-saving and organic producers, creating mutual economic profit for both farmers and buyers. 

⚙️ Tools, Coding Languages & Software

  • Core Development: Python, Streamlit, HTML, CSS; source code hosted on GitHub and web application deployed via Streamlit Community Cloud.
  • Open Data Sources & APIs: NASA POWER API, ISRIC SoilGrids, FAO ECOCROP, OpenStreetMap Nominatim, Natural Earth, and NOAA GSHHG. Data is accessed through APIs and locally stored datasets (JSON, GeoJSON, CSV).
  • Python Libraries & Frameworks: Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Folium, Streamlit-Folium, Requests, Geopy, Rasterio, PyProj, Shapely, and Deep-Translator.
  • Key Technologies & Features: Interactive geospatial mapping, 9-language localization support, location-specific climate analysis, and rule-based agricultural decision-support algorithms.

🎯 Creativity & Factors Considered

What makes Space on Earth creative is connecting everyday farm management, disaster prevention, and long-term economic incentives in one platform. When designing the system, our team prioritized farmer usability, water conservation, life safety, multilingual accessibility (launching with 9 accurate language options), and realistic implementation. Instead of overwhelming users with technical jargon, we built a simple color-coded visual guide—ranging from 🟢 Green (most suitable) and 🟡 Yellow to 🟠 Orange and 🔴 Red (high risk or critical stress), enabling any producer to make informed, confident decisions within seconds.
